quest.title: An Actor... In the Aquarium?
quest.description: Your friends seem to be admiring the aquarium...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: ...Alright, that was great! Let's just do one more take.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Furina! Oh, plus Columbina and Chiori too! You're still here?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Mmhmm! We just wrapped up filming our B-roll.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh! You mean the fishie acting stuff you were doing? How did it all go?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, we found a suitable actor for the role. The shoot went very smoothly!

dialogues.speaker: Chiori
dialogues.text: You two have a real talent for this whole aquarium thing. Furina was just telling us how you've even inspired her to shoot an underwater documentary.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: I like it too. I can sense how content the little fish are, swimming around. You've done a great job taking care of their needs.

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: I just wish this aquarium could stay here forever. That way, I'd be able to come and visit whenever I wanted.

response.speaker: Chiori
response.text: If you're going to miss it so much, why not add a few more scenic shots to the film?

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: You're right. We should totally shoot some more!

response.speaker: Furina
response.text: Some more shots! Come on now, lights, kamera... Where's my script supervisor? Everyone, take your positions!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's ready! But calling out takes for fish actors is... definitely a new experience, that's for sure.

choices.text: We're so happy you like it!
